original.target_description: Study 2: Canadian undergraduates randomly assigned to view The Thinker versus Discobolus; belief in God on a 0–100 scale; independent-groups comparison.

n.location: p. 495 (PDF p. 4), Table 2, Study 2 Art, N column
n.sample_role: Analytic participants by condition: control / analytic prime; not a generic recruited total.
n.exclusions: Main paper states funnel debriefings found no hypothesis awareness; exact exclusion count not established in this cached main paper.

replication.target_description: Direct replication of original Study 2 visual analytic prime, belief in God 0–100; Table 2 All Replication Sites row, random-effects synthesis across four sites. The supplied study_r 2 identifies the original paradigm; this article has one replication experiment with four samples.

n.location: Table 2, All Replication Sites, N_D/N_T column
n.sample_role: Participants retained for analysis, Discobolus / Thinker conditions across four replication sites; random-effects synthesis contains four site estimates.
n.exclusions: Two school participants excluded for guessing the hypothesis; 80 online participants excluded under preregistered quality criteria (location, instruction check, native language, duration, positive-control outliers, memory check, hypothesis guess).

es.location: Table 2, All Replication Sites, Cohen’s d with 95% CI column

p.location: Table 2, All Replication Sites row and note
p.quote: The bottom row reports the integrated effect size over all the replication sites using a random-effects meta-analysis

reported_success.quote: In contrast, our replication of this study found little to no effect of the experimental manipulation

notes: Original narrative reports d = 0.60, whereas its Table 2 reports d = 0.59 for the same Study 2 comparison; narrative value retained as printed at the supplied p. 4 locator. Original n quote joins the two condition labels and printed counts with a semicolon. Replication Table 2 has four individual-site effects and a pooled effect; absent a narrower sample locator, the All Replication Sites row is retained. No p for that pooled random-effects effect is printed in Table 2 or the article narrative; p = .38 belongs to the omnibus ANOVA (eta-squared = 0.001), and p = 0.13 belongs to heterogeneity, so neither is paired with pooled d. The replication table sample sizes are post-exclusion counts, confirmed by Methods. No effect-size conversion performed.
